items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: And he says, oh then you were with Pike Davis band backed Bill Robinson.

ctx.x: But Zuddy can come up with things at night when we're sitting here. Don't you remember, and I say, no I don't remember that. And it will come to me in a couple of days, you know, who it was that he was talking about.

What we've done today actually, we've done, now we've done, we really started this in St. Louis you see. And we've done Chicago and we've come to New York. And he says, oh then you were with Pike Davis band backed Bill Robinson. Pike Davis band and you backed Bill Robinson.
Oh yes. Well that was in the La Fayette Theater.
